svg.title: Dense dashboard layout, version 2.3
svg.text: A working dashboard over a living-world backdrop
Backgrounds show progress. Controls and information belong to compact panels.
Smith | Employees | Mine | Smelter | Forge | Shop | Customers | Legacy Gold / Settings
Room title / stage Room currency / Upgrades
NEXT STEP - Current objective or pinned upgrade with total prerequisite cost
KEY FIGURES - Capacity | Workers | Materials | Progress | Currency
PRIMARY WORKSPACE
Smith: player name, attributes, furnishings, mastery; Employees: four departments
Mine: ore seams and worker assignment slots
Smelter: ore → ingots / alloys; batch queue and optional ingot targets
Forge: compact recipe → material → enchantment; 1 / 5 / max within reach
Shop: displays above compact warehouse; requests and customers beside them
Customers: unlock fixed classes; profiles and live adventures
CONTEXT
Active work and time remaining
Resources and storage
Equipped items / quest records
Follow hero and party policies
3 levels per tier, 5 wins each
All work continues while overlays are open. Manual navigation ends automatic hero following.
Mobile: scroll compact panels; fixed crafting controls and accessible ingot-target settings.
